title: Finding
description: One guideline violation found in the reviewed change.

id.description: F1, F2, ... Reviewers number their own findings; the final report renumbers them.

description.description: What is wrong at the cited lines and why it violates the referenced rules.

references.description: Rule IDs (ERR-4), linter rules (linter:errors-doc), or guide sections without IDs (coding-style.md#test-names, pr-review.md#pr-title-convention).

file.description: Path relative to the repository root, or null for a finding about the PR itself (e.g. its title).

line_range.description: Inclusive 1-based [start, end] on the reviewed commit, or null when no line applies.

in_diff.description: Whether the change under review introduced the violation; false for pre-existing problems in surrounding code.

suggestion.description: The fix to make, in prose.

diff.description: A unified diff (a/ and b/ prefixes, paths from the repository root) that applies with `git apply` at the reviewed commit, or null.
